locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Omne ergo quod movetur, oportet ab alio moveri
interpretation: Ab alio is read as numerical distinctness of the mover from the moved thing, in the respect of the motion. This is a different proposition from STMT-EVERY-MOVING-THING-MOVED-BY-SOMETHING (Aristotle, Physics VII.1), which says only 'by something' and is reached by a divisibility argument rather than by act and potency; the two statements are kept separate.
